# DSH Canvas

> DSH Canvas is a free desktop app for macOS (Apple silicon, macOS 13.5 or later) that turns AI conversations into a tree on an infinite canvas. Instead of one linear chat, every reply is a card you can branch from, so you can return to any earlier point and ask the part you skipped, and see the whole topic as a map. It runs on your Mac, uses the model provider and API key you choose (for example DeepSeek or OpenRouter), and stores canvases as local files. It is built on the open-source DeepSeek Harness (DSH) engine and is an independent project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

## Key facts
- Price: free for personal and commercial use; not for resale or redistribution as another product.
- Platform: macOS on Apple silicon (Intel and Windows not available yet).
- Privacy: conversations go only to the model provider you configure; the project runs no server that receives them; no analytics or cookies on the website.
- Account: none required; you only need an API key from a model provider.
- Download: https://github.com/pipiandxixi/dsh-canvas-releases/releases/latest/download/DSH-Canvas-arm64.dmg (signed and notarized by Apple)
